_source: TEAMMATES_5.110 Modular architecture - Final.docx (SAEroCon), restated; the testDriver convention is ours, marked
common.util: util subsystem of Common: utilities used across the application
common.exception: exception subsystem of Common: the application's exceptions
common.dataTransfer: datatransfer subsystem of Common: data transfer objects shared by the layers
ui.automated: automated subsystem of the UI layer: actions run automatically by the server (cron jobs, task queues), not by a user's request
ui.controller: controller subsystem of the UI layer: handles user requests and actions
ui.view: view subsystem of the UI layer: page data, templates and UI-specific data transfer for rendering pages
logic.core: core component of the Logic layer: the business logic, shielded by a facade; used from outside only via logic.api
logic.api: coreFacade: the interface (Facade pattern) of the Logic core component; the only way other modules may use the logic
logic.backdoor: backdoor subsystem of the Logic layer: privileged access to the logic for testing and administration
storage.entity: entity subsystem of the Storage layer: persistent entities stored in the Datastore
storage.api: api subsystem of the Storage layer: the database access interface the logic calls
storage.search: search subsystem of the Storage layer: search documents and queries
testDriver: Test Driver subsystem: ALL test code (unit tests, action tests, browser tests, page objects, test utilities), whatever module it tests [convention, stated by us]
client.remoteAPI: remoteapi subsystem of Client: connects to the back-end remotely; not used in production
client.scripts: scripts subsystem of Client: administrative scripts for system administrators (data migration, statistics, analytics); not used in production
